_comment: A service-free string collected by Sink.takeWhile comes back in the Sink's result and names a method of a service the program holds. A Sink's result is untracked (assumption 6) but comes back as an unknown scalar, which may name any method: the named method stays and the bundle runs. The string comes back from the type-modelled Stream and Sink as an unknown scalar, so the unread method may stay (accepted imprecision); it is not checked.
